description: Helps you decide what to ask on a discovery call. You give the framework you use (MEDDPICC, BANT, SPICED, Challenger, Gap Selling or all five) and what you already know about the prospect. You get an opening for the conversation, questions in the language of the prospect's sector and on what your solution covers, questions for each part of the framework, a closing and what to say to an objection. It uses only the inputs you give and says which it did not get. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of customer_interview_kit when you need sales qualification questions for a live opportunity.

contact_permission.description: Optional confirmed fact. Ask whether this person permits further contact; this answer overrides contact-refusal wording in the notes. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "allowed".

deal_stage.description: Stage of conversation. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "first_call".

framework.description: Discovery framework to use. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "meddpicc".

gaps_to_fill.description: Specific information gaps to address. Format is text. For example, "confirm who approves invoice exceptions".

known_metrics.description: Metrics/KPIs already discussed. Format is text. For example, "median approval time measured monthly".

known_pain_points.description: Pain points already identified. Format is text. For example, "invoice exceptions delay month-end close".

prospect_industry.description: Prospect industry for context. Format is text. For example, "manufacturing".

prospect_role.description: Role of person you are meeting with. Format is text. For example, "finance director".

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "logistics_tech".

your_solution.description: Your product/solution for relevant questions. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".
